differential.name: Beta thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia with normal hemoglobin and elevated RBC count is typical in individuals of Asian descent.

differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytosis with low hematocrit suggests possible chronic blood loss (e.g., gastrointestinal) despite normal hemoglobin.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Obesity and chronic sinusitis can cause inflammatory-mediated iron sequestration leading to mild anemia.

differential.name: Aplastic anemia
differential.rationale: Isolated leukopenia with otherwise preserved red cell indices may reflect bone‑marrow hypoplasia.

differential.name: Early myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: Cytopenias in a middle‑aged adult raise concern for a clonal marrow disorder.
